description:
START HERE for any question about funds. Search actively deploying venture capital funds by stage, country, industry and recent closes. Works with no API key at all (keyless trial); see the Cost line at the end for per-fund pricing on agent credits. Returns name, slug, country, stage, fund size, industries, the latest published close (lastCloseDate, lastCloseType) and a durable profile URL. For 'which funds just closed', pass closed_since: results then come newest close first. The `slug` in each result is what every other tool takes as input, so run this first and copy the slug rather than constructing one from a fund's name.
Cost: 1 credit per fund returned (EUR 0.01 each). Default limit 10. Default max_credits 10, hard maximum 25 per call. Billed per fund for agent credits and inline MPP only; Starter and Pro are flat-fee and the keyless trial is free. The cost of each call is reported in the response's billing object.

closed_since.description: Only funds whose latest published close (first, interim or final close, or a launch) is on or after this date, ISO format YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. '2026-09-01'). Close data comes from Fund Momentum's own close coverage, each with a source URL in get_fund's last_close block.

country.description: Country of the fund's headquarters, spelled out in full (e.g. 'United States', 'United Kingdom', 'Germany'). Not an ISO code.

industry.description: Industry focus. Must be one of the listed enum values (lowercase, underscores), e.g. 'ai_ml', 'fintech', 'climate_sustainability'. Common spellings such as 'AI/ML', 'FinTech' or 'climate' are accepted and normalised.

limit.description: Number of results to return. Default 10 for every caller, including agents paying with credits and subscribers, so an omitted limit never returns or bills more than 10 funds. Without a paid account the maximum is 10; a larger value is rejected, not clamped. Agents paying with credits are billed 1 credit (EUR 0.01) per fund returned, up to 150 funds per key per UTC day (a call that would exceed the remainder is refused before any charge); pass a larger limit explicitly to receive more. Starter gets up to 50 per call; Pro gets up to 250 and can page with offset. The response reports `matched` (total matches) and `truncated`.

max_credits.description: Optional spending ceiling for this call, in credits (1 credit = EUR 0.01). Rows returned never exceed floor(max_credits / credits per row). Omitted: the ceiling is the cost of the effective limit (10 credits for the default page). Values above 25 are clamped to 25; zero, negative and non-integer values are rejected before anything is charged. It is a clamp on limit only and does not apply to Starter or Pro. When it cuts the page, the response has truncated: true and truncated_reason: "max_credits".

offset.description: Number of matches to skip, for paging through a large result set (use next_offset from a truncated response). Agents paying with credits and Pro plans only.

stage.description: Funding stage. Matches every fund that invests at this stage, including multi-stage funds whose range covers it (each result lists all its stages in fundingStages). Must be one of the listed enum values (lowercase, underscores). Common spellings such as 'Pre-Seed' or 'Series A' are accepted and normalised.
